payload.title: Share one guest credential provider per build process; single-flight, cache, jittered backoff; cap static generation workers
payload.description: TI main build on Amplify still fails at static prerender with TooManyRequestsException Rate exceeded despite #206. Cause: runWithAmplifyServerContext({nextServerContext:null}) builds a fresh Cognito credentials provider per call, so each page/read issues its own GetId/GetCredentialsForIdentity, multiplied by Next static-generation workers. Fix: one process-wide provider with single-flight and expiry cache, full-jitter backoff with a 2 minute budget, and capped static generation concurrency in withPapyrus.
